CustomField.description: Lead bifurcation into Sales & Marketing lead
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Campaign_Id__c)), "Marketing Lead", IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Lead_Source__c, "Digital Platforms"), ISPICKVAL(Lead_Source__c, "Website"), ISPICKVAL(Lead_Source__c, "Social Media") ), "Digital Marketing Leads", "Sales Lead" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Lead bifurcation into Sales & Marketing lead
CustomField.label: Sales / Marketing Lead
